title: GTA 6 Gameplay Unexpectedly Appears in Latest South Park Episode
description: GTA 6 marketing reaches unexpected new heights as brand new gameplay footage, featuring Jason and anti-social behavior, appears in South Park.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Marketing Reaches Unexpected New Heights in South Park

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the upcoming release of *GTA 6* on November 19, Rockstar Games has continued to roll out its massive global marketing campaign. We already know about the marketing deal with Sony and the PlayStation 5, alongside real-world locations being utilized to spread the word about the sandbox blockbuster. However, it appears Rockstar's promotional reach truly knows no bounds, as brand new gameplay footage unexpectedly cropped up in the latest episode of *South Park*.

## Dog Poo, Anti-Social Behavior, and Jason

According to reports from Eurogamer, the unexpected television cameo featured a glimpse into the chaotic world of *GTA 6*. The footage showcased elements including dog poo, anti-social behavior, and a look at Jason. Dropping game footage into an iconic, satirical animated series like *South Park* is a brilliant and unconventional way to keep the hype train moving forward, fitting right in with the chaotic energy the franchise is known for.

## Counting Down to November 19

With the launch date fast approaching, Rockstar's creative marketing choices are keeping fans on their toes. Whether through traditional platform partnerships with Sony or surprising pop-culture crossovers, the anticipation for the return to the open-world sandbox has never been higher.

### Editor's Take
Rockstar utilizing *South Park* to showcase a peek at *GTA 6* gameplay is a masterclass in modern marketing. It breaks away from traditional trailers and reaches audiences in the most unexpected ways. As we count down to November 19, this kind of creative surprise only fuels our excitement for the final release.
